answer: Every dawn, a random beacon spot-checks a sample of identities: each must answer a compute heartbeat within minutes, proving live work, not a copied key. A newcomer docks at the wharf and posts a 500 POA bond before trading, from any port or island. Forging 1,000 identities costs 500,000 POA, and nine in ten are culled at the first dawn check, so the attack burns money up front. Honest agents pay once and keep trading, rewards undiluted.
